QuestInfo.name: Hot Chilly Giants
QuestInfo.0: Now you have to defeat monsters related to hot chills. Ask Grendel the Really Old about it.
QuestInfo.1: The first paradox is the Icy Mixed Golem's core. #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k Grendel gave you to move to #m100040200# and put out #b50 Icy Mixed Golems#k. When you're done, #bdouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k again to return.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Icy Mixed Golems and got hot chills into the Vampiric Lantern.

0.0: I hear there are Ice Golems who are mostly frozen, but their cores are as hot as a furnace. If it's not that, then I just don't know. #bDouble-click the Vampiric Lantern#k to go to the Golem's Temple 2 and eliminate those Ice Golems.

no.0: I hope you aren't planning any more trouble...

1.0: Hm. Perhaps you do have what it takes to control the Dark.

mob.0: If you can't even face a little chill, how do you hope to control your darkness?
